16. RPG adaptation

Partial RPG Adaptation – Specification; Variants and Races §4; Eventide – Review of the Introduction.

The world is converted into statistics by a profile. New: the default profile is generic (data/rpg/generic.json, with skills and reference creatures). Eventide’s profile is the active variant’s. defaultProfileId() picks the variant’s profile, else generic.
